source_discovery: Daily research automation proposes source-card updates; runner uses reviewed manifest snapshots and does not crawl.

sources.title: Learning from human preferences
sources.finding: Human judgments between behavior clips guide a learned reward; uncertain comparisons inform further feedback.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Collect consented pairwise robot-behavior judgments; retain ties, abstentions, rater disagreement and delayed outcomes.

sources.title: Learning dexterity
sources.finding: Dactyl learned control in randomized simulation and was tested on a physical robot.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Vary friction, lighting, geometry, latency and wear in simulation; validate transfer separately on real robots.

sources.title: Solving Rubik’s Cube with a robot hand
sources.finding: Automatic domain randomization expanded training-environment variation as the system improved.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Expand stress-test ranges only after predefined simulated performance checks; never equate simulated time with residence time.

sources.title: Aligning language models to follow instructions
sources.finding: Human demonstrations and output comparisons supported supervised training and reward-model-based optimization.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Keep high-quality demonstrations, corrections and real-human preference pairs in separate, purpose-authorized datasets.

sources.title: Learning to play Minecraft with Video PreTraining
sources.finding: Action-labeled contractor recordings trained an inverse-dynamics model used to label additional video.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Explore action inference from permissioned robot video; mark inferred actions as weak labels, not sensor ground truth.

sources.title: OpenAI Red Teaming Network
sources.finding: External domain specialists contributed risk taxonomies and adversarial evaluation across development stages.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Maintain independent safety reviewers and a failure-to-regression-test queue; bot review cannot issue certification.

sources.title: OpenAI Data Partnerships
sources.finding: The program described public and private dataset partnerships, curation and access controls.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Arrange explicit-purpose data contributions from labs, manufacturers and consenting participants; no agreement is implied.

sources.title: Sycophancy in GPT-4o
sources.finding: OpenAI reported that overemphasis on short-term feedback contributed to overly agreeable behavior.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Measure lasting benefit, burden and freedom to reject; do not reward flattery, dependency or distress at withdrawal.

sources.title: Evaluation best practices
sources.finding: The guide advocates production-relevant cases, human calibration, logging and evaluation as systems change.
sources.hilo_adaptation: Mine verified failures into versioned regression suites; protect sealed holdouts and a frozen official scoring protocol.
